title: Eventual vanishing of a section in an etale sheaf colimit
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. Let $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $G:\mathcal I\to\mathrm{Mod}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ be a diagram of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], indexed by a small filtered category $\mathcal I$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $(H,(c_i))$ be a colimit cocone of $G$. Let $U\to X$ be an object of $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ whose underlying scheme is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For any object $i$ of $\mathcal I$ and $s\in G_i(U)$ such that $(c_i)_U(s)=0$, there exist an object $j$ and an arrow $f:i\to j$ such that $G(f)_U(s)=0$. No quasi-separatedness assumption is made on $U$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0738 (lemma-directed-colimits-sections), proof of part (2), applied to the etale site as in Etale Cohomology, Tag 03Q4 (section-colimit)

proof.text: Form the sectionwise module presheaf colimit $P$. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful], its sheafification is the underlying colimit sheaf $H$, compatibly with all coprojections. For constant coefficients the category of module sheaves is the category of sheaves with values in $\Lambda$-modules. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] to the underlying presheaf of sets: the class of $s$ equals zero locally on a covering of $U$.

A morphism between objects of the small etale site is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. Its image is open by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-morphism-open-map]. The images of the witnessing covering arrows form an open cover of the quasi-compact scheme $U$. Choose a finite subfamily still covering $U$; it remains a covering of the etale site.

For each member of this finite covering, [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise] gives an arrow out of $i$ killing the restriction of $s$. Filteredness gives a cocone over the finite diagram consisting of $i$, the finitely many target objects, and their arrows from $i$; thus there is one arrow $i\to j$ factoring compatibly through every killing arrow. Its transport of $s$ restricts to zero on all members. By [lem-weil-pbc-pretopology-sheaf-condition], separatedness of $G_j$ gives $G(i\to j)_U(s)=0$. For an empty covering, $G_i(U)$ is zero and the identity arrow suffices.

lean.statement: theorem etale_section_colimit_eventual_zero (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] (U : X.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left] (I : Type w) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (G : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{max v w} Λ)) (c : Cocone G) (hc : IsColimit c) : ∀ (i : I) (s : (G.obj i).obj.obj (Opposite.op U)), ((c.ι.app i).hom.app (Opposite.op U)).hom s = 0 → ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), ((G.map f).hom.app (Opposite.op U)).hom s = 0
